name: ZCA_ROLLUPS_B
description: This table stores the metadata of various rollups that are defined for different source objects and their related objects.

columns.name: ROLLUP_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for the rollup.

columns.name: ROLLUP_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Specifies the type of the rollup. Valid values are ORA_REGULAR (Regular) and ORA_AGING (Aging).

columns.name: SOURCE_OBJ_CODE
columns.description: Name of the source object. Foreign key to LANG_INDEPENDENT_CODE column in ZCA_OBJECTS table.

columns.name: SOURCE_STORAGE_OBJ_CODE
columns.description: Name of the source rollup storage object. Foreign key to LANG_INDEPENDENT_CODE column in ZCA_OBJECTS table.

columns.name: SOURCE_OBJ_ROLLUP_TABLE
columns.description: Name of the table where calculated rollup data of the source object is stored.

columns.name: SOURCE_OBJ_ATTR
columns.description: View object attribute name of the source object's rollup attribute.

columns.name: SOURCE_OBJ_ATTR_TYPE
columns.description: Rollup attribute type. Derived from ZCA_OBJECT_ATTRIUTES.ATTR_TYPE. Supported values are NUMBER and TIMESTAMP.

columns.name: SOURCE_OBJ_FILTER
columns.description: Filter expression that would be used to filter the source object data.

columns.name: RELATED_OBJ_CODE
columns.description: Name of the related object. Foreign key to LANG_INDEPENDENT_CODE column in ZCA_OBJECTS table.

columns.name: RELATIONSHIP_NAME_LIC
columns.description: Name of the relationship between source and related objects. Foreign key to RELATIONSHIP_NAME_LIC column in ZCA_OBJECT_RELATIONS table.

columns.name: RELATED_OBJ_ATTR
columns.description: View object attribute name of the related object's rollup attribute.

columns.name: RELATED_OBJ_FILTER
columns.description: Filter expression that would be used to filter the related object data.

columns.name: FUNCTION_CODE
columns.description: Aggregation function code that is used to calculate the rollup data. Valid values include ORA_SUM (Sum), ORA_COUNT (Count), ORA_MAX (Max), and ORA_MIN (Min).

columns.name: REFRESH_THRESHOLD
columns.description: The maximum number of days set as the threshold for the selection of Activity or Interactions records.

columns.name: HIERARCHY_FLAG
columns.description: Specifies if the hierarchy rollup is enabled or not.

columns.name: HIERARCHY_ATTR
columns.description: View object attribute name of the source object's hierarchy rollup attribute.

columns.name: STATUS_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if the rollup is active or deleted.

columns.name: FREQUENCY
columns.description: Indicates the frequency of the rollup data refresh.

columns.name: FREQUENCY_UNIT_CODE
columns.description: Rollup data refresh frequency unit. Valid values include ORA_HOUR (Hour), ORA_DAY (Day), ORA_WEEK (Week), and ORA_MONTH (Month).

columns.name: COMPILED_SOURCE_AMT_CONV
columns.description: Generated expression to convert the amount field value to corporate currency.

columns.name: COMPILED_FULL_SQL
columns.description: Internal attribute to store the full refresh SQL.

columns.name: COMPILED_INCREMENTAL_SQL
columns.description: Internal attribute to store the incremental refresh SQL.

columns.name: COMPILED_OBJ_LIST_SQL
columns.description: Internal attribute to store the object list refresh SQL.

columns.name: PUBLISHED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if the rollup is published or not.

columns.name: PUBLISHED_DATE
columns.description: Date when the rollup was published.

columns.name: PUBLISHED_BY
columns.description: User Name of the user who published the rollup.

columns.name: LAST_SUCCESSFUL_RUN
columns.description: Date of the last successful full or incremental run of the back-end job that calculates the rollup attribute value.

columns.name: LAST_PROCESSED_DATE
columns.description: Date of the last full or incremental run of the back-end job that calculates the rollup attribute value.

columns.name: LAST_PROCESSED_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Status of the last full or incremental run of the back-end job that calculates the rollup attribute value. Valid values include ORA_SUCCESS (SUCCESS) and ORA_ERROR (Error).

columns.name: ERROR_MESSAGE
columns.description: Error message of the full or incremental run of the back-end job that calculates the rollup attribute value.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET1
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET1. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET2
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET2. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: NRT_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if the rollup is enabled for Near Real Time Calculation.

columns.name: BOFO_LINKSET_REFRESH_SQL
columns.description: Internal attribute to store the back office linkset refresh SQL.

columns.name: EXPLAINABILITY_METADATA
columns.description: This column stores the rollup explainability metadata in json format.
